status: CAD fit prototype, not physically tested

parameters.design: One-piece V4 — eleven screw-free interchangeable rotor/grip modules
parameters.return: tactile switch internal dome only; physical test required
parameters.service: Pull both opposed tabs outward 0.8 mm and lift the top module; undo four PCB screws for cell access
parameters.cap_style_change: Pull the two base tabs outward, lift out the complete top, snap in another one-piece module
parameters.magnet_installation: One diametrically magnetized diameter 5 x thickness 1.5 mm disc in each module; retain with adhesive after fit and field checks

strain_estimate_note: Only a sizing estimate for a straight cantilever; curved beam torsion, print anisotropy, root stress and fatigue are not validated
cap_clearance_method: All low cap geometry is outside R26.8; hook tops are below the deck and inside R24.084; release pads are 0.65 mm below the pressed grip edge
snap_insertion_note: Upper hook ramp provides insertion cam; force and automatic re-engagement require printed testing
physical_checks_required: Snap insertion, outward-release force and repeated-removal fatigue
Cap return, friction and edge pressing
Retention pull-off load and print tolerances
Actual switch height and electrical closing before stop
Each module magnet polarity, installed depth and PCB/cell service
